Fish B: small, slender long fish, blue/teal, elongated ellipse body, pointed tail, single small fin, eye, mouth line. Different speeds: big fish slow, small fish fast. Fish should flip direction? They swim horizontally across screen. If they swim left-to-right, they need to face right. Use scaleX(-1) on inner group when direction is negative. Simpler: both swim rightwards but different speeds, or one rightwards one leftwards. Wrap-around: when x > W + margin, x = -margin; when x < -margin, x = W + margin. I'll do: big fish swims right slowly; small fish swims left faster. Inner group mirrored depending on direction. Also add vertical bobbing (sin) and slight rotation tied to bobbing derivative, plus tail wiggle via animateTransform or JS.
